segments.text_en: Cosmic decision and divine selection
evidence: It was time to decide destinies in heaven and on earth
Lagash had raised the head towards heaven in large ‘me’
Enlil looked righteously upon lord Ningirsu
The ‘heart’ of Enlil, it is the river Tigris, did it not bring sweet water?

segments.text_en: Divine command to build Eninnu
evidence: To the house its king spoke
I will make the ‘me’ of Eninnu emerge in heaven and on earth
The governor is wise, he shall pay attention
‘Build his house!,’ he ordered him

segments.text_en: Gudea's confusion and petition for interpretation
evidence: Gudea, his ‘heart’ is distant
Of what my ‘dark goat’ has revealed to me, its ‘heart’ I did not know
Let me bring my dream to her, to my mother
Nanše, my divine sister from Siraran, may she make its meaning visible for me

segments.text_en: Journey to Bagara and prayer to Ningirsu
evidence: Did he not set foot on his barge?
he sacrificed bread, he poured out cold water
Hero, you spoke to me, let me do it right for you
His (Gudea’s) prayer was being heard

segments.text_en: Petition to Gatumdu for protective signs
evidence: I am a no-mother-haver, you are my mother
You have placed my semen in the inside: you bore me in the cella
you are my big dagger, following my side
With the index finger? of your right hand, ‘stroke’ me with it my lady Gatumdu

segments.text_en: Prayer to Nanše and recounting of the dream
evidence: Inside the dream there was one man, his greatness was like heaven
She held a stylus of purified silver in the hand
She had the tablet of the stars on her lap
the brick of deciding destinies was placed in the mold for me

segments.text_en: Nanše interprets the dream symbols
evidence: it is surely my brother Ningirsu
That is surely Nisaba, my sister
it is Nindubba, placing the house on the plan of the house
that is surely the righteous brick of Eninnu

segments.text_en: Instructions for ritual preparation and offering
evidence: after you have prepared a chariot for your king
after you decorated this chariot with purified silver and lapis
his beloved harp, ‘dragon of the land’
he will receive your small word, as if it was a mighty word

segments.text_en: Gudea prepares materials and enters Eninnu
evidence: He broke the seal of his treasure house, he brought out wood
He put the oak wood to the axe
With his beloved harp, ‘dragon of the land’
Joyfully he entered to him in the house

segments.text_en: Ritual purification and second petition for a sign
evidence: fattened(?) sheep, fat-tail sheep, fattened goats
Juniper, the pure tree of the mountain he placed on the fire
my sign is my not
I don’t understand its ‘heart’

segments.text_en: Ningirsu reveals the temple plan and promises abundance
evidence: I will surely give you the sign of the building of my house
My house, Eninnu, founded by An
Like the Anzu, its shriek, makes the heaven tremble
I will let bounty come to you from the heaven

segments.text_en: Confirmation through divination and social justice
evidence: He struck the hand into the goat, his goat is good
For Gudea, the ‘heart’ of Ningirsu it is the light, that dawned on him
He returned accusations
To the governor, building Eninnu, to Gudea, no man brought accusations

segments.text_en: Purification of the city and brick molding ritual
evidence: The governor cleansed the city, he spun it with fire
An impure, a terrible one, a leper(?), he brought out from the city
he made the brick appear by the goat
it is Anzu, his royal emblem, he made it shine as a sign

segments.text_en: Mobilization of labor and tribute from foreign lands
evidence: On that day, the governor arranged a levy in his land
Elam came to him from Elam
Magan and Meluhha, from their land, submitted to him
Its copper, like bringing much grain

segments.text_en: Extraction and transport of precious materials
evidence: He cut down its cedars with the great axe
Its large stones, in blocks, he brought
gold from its mountain, in its dust was brought to him
Carneol, like flowers, from Meluhha

segments.text_en: Divine inspiration and measurement of the foundation
evidence: he does not allow sleep to enter during midnight
Nisaba, the house of wisdom, she opened for him
Enki made the plan of the house right for him
he placed sticks on its border, he knew himself

segments.text_en: Ritual brick making and laying of the first brick
evidence: The shiny basket, the righteous mold of deciding destinies
He greased it with honey, butter oil, and fine butter oil
Gudea placed clay in the mold
He shook the mold, he threw the brick to dry

segments.text_en: Presentation of the brick and confirmation of the plan
evidence: it is a shiny throne raised to heaven
it is the shiny team of Utu shaking its head
it is Nisaba whose ‘heart’ knows counting
he stretched his hand in the goat, his goat was good

segments.text_en: Second dream revelation and foundation rituals
evidence: Gudea lying by the top, he slept, the word dawned on him
the separation of Eninnu from heaven and earth, was brought to his attention
He threw the flax, he perfected the me
Enki places the foundation of the house

segments.text_en: Sevenfold blessing and construction of the superstructure
evidence: he gave a blessing, he stroked the brick with flax
It is Anzu spreading its wings over the calfs
It is the green sky, lifting terrifying radiance
It is Eninnu—Moon passing (through)—filling the land

segments.text_en: Completion and cosmic integration of Eninnu
evidence: They make the house grow like a mountain
They make it float in the middle of the heaven like a cloud
The house raised the head to heaven like a mountain in heaven and earth
it is the dragon of Abzu rising in its terror

segments.text_en: Erection of named stelae and dedication
evidence: ‘the stela, king filling the courtyard
as name of that stone he named
Lord Ningirsu made Gudea known from Girnun,’
He build the house of his king with righteousness

segments.text_en: Architectural symbolism and interior furnishing
evidence: made it grow like a mountain of Lapis
Its ‘dubla’ stood (there) like an aurochs
The cedar doors standing in the house, it is Iškur roaring from heaven
Its upper lintel, it is Eninnu coiled up, the roaring storm

segments.text_en: Functional description of temple precincts and final praise
evidence: They prepare the meal in the great sanctuary
He built the bedroom
The wine-cellar(?) (called) ‘mountain dripping with wine’
For the restoration of Eninnu Ningirsu be praised!
